notes: Distinguished log entries, the reference points every user checks against. `size` is the tree size, `window` the Reasonable Monitoring Window, and `timestamps` a position-to-timestamp map the algorithm may consult. `rightmost` is the rightmost distinguished entry and `previous_rightmost` the rightmost one left of the log's last entry, both absent where there is none. `requested` lists the positions the peer asked about, in order: the peer reaches these answers by walking the frontier rather than by running §6.1's recursion, so which entries it needed to see is part of what is being pinned.
